subject: Re: MAP - Evaluation bridge playbook & access safeguards
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jane Miller <jane.miller@brightretail.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + sample handoff proposal (BrightRetail)

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for the demo today. Per our conversation, attached is a concise playbook that maps milestone dates to deliverables for the evaluation: a 3-week trial window, sample prompt pack, and a lightweight test-case run. High-level asks:

- BrightRetail signs the Mutual Action Plan (MPA) PDF we shared via DocuSign (link below)
- DataExchange to push the ephemeral sample bundle to the secure Drive folder (read-only, watermarking)
- Redwood provides a 30-day ephemeral access token for a managed sandbox (no export)

Important usage constraints we need you to confirm before we ship:
- No training or model re-use outside the scoped evaluation; samples may not be redistributed or published
- Identifiers redacted; PII removed per the attached manifest notes
- Access revocation scheduled at the close date; assets to be destroyed after 90 days unless otherwise agreed

Attachments: BR_eval_sample_manifest_v1.csv, promptpack_readme_v1.md, MAP-timeline-BrightRetail-2027-04-20.pdf

Proposed MAP milestones (short):
1) 2027-04-20 — MPA signed, sample bundle live in folder
2) 2027-04-21 — Redwood provides sandbox credentials & sample ingestion guide
3) 2027-04-21 to 2027-05-11 — Evaluation window (3 weeks)
4) 2027-05-12 — Acceptance gate: BrightRetail returns pass/fail checklist and selects next steps

Can you confirm the constraints above and whether DataExchange Ops should be the party uploading the bundle, or if your eng team will do it? Once we have confirmation we’ll trigger DocuSign and a one-click sandbox invite.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Partner Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Jane Miller <jane.miller@brightretail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@dataexchange.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + sample handoff proposal (BrightRetail)

Thanks Irene — this looks good and tidy. A few quick notes: 

- Confirmed: BrightRetail will not train on the assets or redistribute. Legal will add a single line to the MPA about non-derivative use.
- Our eng team prefers DataExchange Ops to upload the bundle; ops@dataexchange.com is copied. Can you give them the expected manifest format?
- Can you make the sandbox credentials SSO-enabled (we use Okta)? We want to avoid shared credentials.

One small ask on timing: we have a store holiday freeze week starting 2027-04-26. Can the evaluation window start 2027-04-21 and we try to front-load key test cases by 2027-04-25? If the MAP supports that, we should be fine.

Jane
Jane Miller
Head of ML Platform
BrightRetail
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jane Miller <jane.miller@brightretail.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, ops@dataexchange.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + sample handoff proposal (BrightRetail)

Jane — appreciate the quick reply and the holiday note. Updated plan:

- We’ll shift the acceptance gate window to allow heavy ingestion on 21–25 April and resume light monitoring during the freeze. Final acceptance still targeted for 2027-05-12.
- Marcus will share the manifest template for DataExchange to use; it matches the attached CSV schema but adds a per-file SHA256 column.
- Sandbox will be Okta SSO. Grace will coordinate a short SAML exchange and send an Okta app invite once the MPA is signed.
- Legal tweak is fine; the DocuSign link includes an editable clause.

Forwarding to DataExchange Ops with the manifest and playbook so they can confirm upload timing.

Best,
Irene

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Final prep checklist before DocuSign

Internal checklist before we trigger the MPA DocuSign: 

1) Confirm DataExchange has scheduled upload for 2027-04-20 18:00 UTC and shared the Drive folder link.
2) Ensure manifest CSV includes columns: filename, size_bytes, sha256, record_count, pii_redacted (true/false).
3) Create a short runbook for BrightRetail: ingestion steps, sample queries, and acceptance checklist. Link to draft runbook in Drive.
4) Grace to provision Okta SSO and send test invite to jane.miller@brightretail.com.
5) Legal to confirm the non-derivative clause is visible in DocuSign before sending.

Once items 1–4 are green we proceed with DocuSign and invite the BrightRetail contacts. Target to close the MAP on 2027-04-20 EOD PT.

-Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
